title: Skydive Castroville - San Antonio
specs: Jump from 12,000 feet with freefall of 35-45 seconds at speeds over 125 mph
Parachute opens at 5,000 feet with 5-7 minute peaceful descent
Scenic views of Texas Hill Country, San Antonio skyline, Medina River, and Castroville poppies
Must be 18 years or older with valid ID (Driver's License, ID card, Passport)
Maximum weight 235 lbs; over 200 lbs must be at least 5'8" tall, exceptions may apply
No alcohol, drugs, or being under influence to board aircraft
Must obey all airport rules and regulations
Two tandem pairs per aircraft flight

blurb: Guests experience tandem skydiving over Texas Hill Country and the San Antonio skyline, securely harnessed to certified instructors. The jump includes freefall from 12,000 feet, parachute deployment at 5,000 feet, and a 5-7 minute parachute ride. Experienced jumpers can purchase jump tickets and participate in special events like skydiving during solar eclipses.
